purpose: Source notes for a staged Cáceres parcel and claim review using selected public SIGPAC references, not one actual holding, an eligibility decision or a filing connector.

sources.title: Resolucion de 30 de enero de 2026: mantenimiento y actualizacion del SIGPAC
sources.edition: DOE 23, 4 February 2026, pages 6464-6496; original resolution dated 30 January 2026
sources.retrieval: Official HTML opened; relevant returned sections read. Not a complete amendment audit.

supports.fact: SIGPAC does not establish ownership or legally recognised property boundaries.
The declarant checks graphical boundaries and land use against reality, and separately checks that pasture CSP reflects the admissible percentage.
PR means pasto arbustivo: naturally producing forage with notable shrubs. Shrubs alone do not establish ineligibility.
A discrepancy needs a reasoned, documented modification request to the competent regional SIGPAC authority.
CSP determines maximum admissible pasture area. Temporary unproductive elements may require further deductions from the declaration.
Type 7 concerns whole-recinto CSP change; type 8 concerns splitting a recinto to change CSP on part.

unknowns: No scheme eligibility certification or official rounding rule established.

sources.title: Alegaciones al Sistema de Informacion Geografica de la Politica Agraria Comunitaria (SIGPAC)
sources.retrieval: Official search excerpts read and official page opened; response exposed page metadata rather than its complete body.

supports.fact: Evidence depends on allegation type; listed categories include dated georeferenced photographs, technical report, use-right documentation and livestock-use report. They are not all mandatory for every case.
Electronic submission uses SGA, by the person, a representative or an authorised collaborating entity.

unknowns: SGA App-specific evidence capture or submission functionality not verified.
No API, import format, prefill access or successful authority acceptance verified.
Service text describes the resolution by its publication date; the original legal act is dated 30 January 2026.

sources.title: FEGA SIGPAC current-service recintos and attribute records, explicit CRS84 capture
sources.edition: Current-service capture on 17 October 2026; source campaign not established.
sources.retrieval: Five complete public recintos from the locally retained explicit OGC:CRS84 response, with attribute records joined by the seven reference components. No private farmer account, ownership lookup or claim submission.
sources.attribution: Recintos SIGPAC © Fondo Español de Garantía Agraria (FEGA), CC BY 4.0.

supports.fact: Five neighboring reference recintos 18, 22, 25, 29 and 26 preserve exact CRS84 coordinates and all holes; their selection does not establish one holding or ownership.
Reference 10:50:0:0:13:29:1 has published superficie 63.0449 ha, admisibilidad/CSP 90, uso_sigpac PR and raw incidencias 140. The incidence meaning has not been established.
56.74041 ha is calculated from 63.0449 × 90 / 100. It is not a supplied official maximum-area field, final eligible area, payment decision or verified rounding rule.

unknowns: Source campaign year is null; retrieval is not campaign or survey date.
No ownership, tenancy, actual claim, private farmer or combined holding established.
No incidence-140 interpretation, final scheme eligibility or payment certification.
Current legal deadlines and authority acceptance remain unverified.

demo_limits.private_original: Staged D04 original uses only the official outer ring, deliberately filling all three actual inner holes. It is not the official geometry; its drawn approximate area differs from the published superficie. Other four private examples preserve their complete public geometry.
demo_limits.correction: Compare the exact published reference, save a private boundary proposal and separately apply it through human review. The published source is never rewritten; the claim-number proposal is a separate action.
demo_limits.arithmetic_note: The product of the published area and CSP is labelled as a calculation. It does not spatially locate exclusions, decide all declaration deductions, establish ownership or imply a payment or penalty.

recommendation: Compare the staged private outline with the unchanged complete public reference, explicitly save and review a real private proposal, and separately check the proposed claim number and every source. If disputing SIGPAC, prepare a reasoned evidence packet for the applicable official route. No private edit, model calculation or reviewed folder is an official update, submitted correction or authority acceptance.
research_limits: The two earlier legal-source notes remain a limited review, not an exhaustive amendment or national-deadline audit. The public parcel data comes from the separately retained current-service capture and exact joined attribute records. PNOA capture date and source campaign remain unknown. No private farmer account, ownership verification, form submission or authority acceptance was performed.
